rationale: DRAFT_UNSIGNED: proposes adoption of requirements revision 62 and architecture revision 8 for the Phase 3 operational money path. It fixes the nine-stage order, provider and chain-attempt recovery contracts, persisted purchase, mode, and custody records, canonical transaction-policy wire tag, bounded Operations rotation, and Collector response facts. This draft grants no deployment, credential use, signing, broadcast, asset movement, spending, or publication authority.
